confirmation_eligibility: only survivors of the discovery predicate are eligible for the strictly-later 2018-H1 internal confirmation stage; confirmation is a separate gate

requirements.cost_stress: net_bps > 0 at both 1.5x and 2.0x cost stress
requirements.data_integrity: no 2018+ pre-discovery reads; deterministic reproduction PASS
requirements.fold_robustness: positive net_bps in >= 60% of purged walk-forward test folds
requirements.multiple_testing: Romano-Wolf step-down p <= 0.05 against frozen denominator
requirements.risk_adjusted: annualised daily Sharpe >= 0.5 on discovery region
